rules.name: spyware_surveillance_exfil_combo
rules.description: Combination of microphone/camera/location capture APIs with network exfiltration strings, as documented for commercial spyware families (e.g. Pegasus-style capability sets). Single capabilities are common in legitimate apps; the combination is the indicator.

meta.rationale: capability-combination rule; tune to your environment
meta.reference: public spyware capability reporting (Amnesty MVT, Kaspersky, Apple platform security guides)

rules.name: persistence_launchd_daemon_abuse
rules.description: Strings consistent with installing a rogue LaunchDaemon for persistence: a system LaunchDaemons path plus RunAtLoad/KeepAlive keys written together.

meta.rationale: persistence technique T1543/COM: launch agents and daemons
meta.reference: Apple Platform Security: launching daemons and agents

rules.name: keychain_credential_harvest_combo
rules.description: Keychain enumeration API combined with generic-password class queries and serialized export markers; associated with credential-theft tooling.

meta.rationale: combination rule; SecItem usage alone is normal

rules.name: tcc_privacy_database_probing
rules.description: Direct references to the TCC privacy database and its schema table, which legitimate apps do not perform; consistent with privacy-control probing or tampering preparation.

meta.rationale: TCC.db access is reserved to the OS; app references are anomalous

rules.name: sandbox_profile_denial_markers
rules.description: Embedded sandbox-profile denial directives; useful for flagging samples that introspect sandbox restrictions during analysis.

meta.rationale: informational; common in research tooling too
